description: This file defines a PHP class QAppsClient within the Aws\QApps namespace, extending the AwsClient class, and documenting various methods for interacting with the QApps service via the AWS SDK.

classes.name: QAppsClient
classes.description: A client class used to interact with the QApps service in AWS, providing methods to perform various QApps-related operations asynchronously and synchronously.

methods.name: associateLibraryItemReview
methods.description: Associates a review to a library item.

methods.name: associateLibraryItemReviewAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously associates a review to a library item.

methods.name: associateQAppWithUser
methods.description: Associates a QApp with a user.

methods.name: associateQAppWithUserAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously associates a QApp with a user.

methods.name: batchCreateCategoryAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates multiple categories in batch.

methods.name: batchDeleteCategoryAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes multiple categories in batch.

methods.name: batchUpdateCategoryAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously updates multiple categories in batch.

methods.name: createLibraryItemAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new library item.

methods.name: createPresignedUrl
methods.description: Creates a presigned URL for accessing resources.

methods.name: describeQAppPermissionsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously describes permissions for a QApp.

methods.name: disassociateLibraryItemReview
methods.description: Removes a review association from a library item.

methods.name: disassociateLibraryItemReviewAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously removes a review association from a library item.

methods.name: disassociateQAppFromUser
methods.description: Disassociates a QApp from a user.

methods.name: disassociateQAppFromUserAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously disassociates a QApp from a user.

methods.name: getLibraryItem
methods.description: Retrieves details of a library item.

methods.name: getLibraryItemAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves details of a library item.

methods.name: getQAppAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves details of a QApp.

methods.name: getQAppSessionMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for a QApp session.

methods.name: getQAppSessionMetadataAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves metadata for a QApp session.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags associated with a resource.

methods.name: listTagsForResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists tags for a resource.

methods.name: predictQAppAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously performs prediction using a QApp.

methods.name: untagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously removes tags from a resource.

methods.name: updateLibraryItemMetadata
methods.description: Updates metadata of a library item.

methods.name: updateLibraryItemMetadataAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously updates metadata of a library item.

methods.name: updateQAppPermissionsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously updates permissions for a QApp.

methods.name: updateQAppSessionMetadata
methods.description: Updates metadata of a QApp session.

methods.name: updateQAppSessionMetadataAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously updates metadata of a QApp session.
